subject: general
question: Which Department of Government of India launched ‘One Health’ pilot project in April 2022?

options.text: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying

solution:
The correct answer is __**Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **One Health pilot project:-**

 
 
• It​ aims to** promote the health and well-being of humans**, animals, and the environment by addressing the **interconnectedness** of these **three domains.**
 
• The project will be implemented in** five districts of India, **namely, **Sonipat (Haryana), Nuh (Haryana), Tonk (Rajasthan), Rohtak (Haryana), and Jhunjhunu (Rajasthan).**
 
• The Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying is responsible for the development of **animal husbandry, dairy farming, and fisheries** in India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Department of Consumer Affairs:-**

 
 
• It​** **is responsible for protecting consumers' interests and ensuring fair trade practices in the market.
 
 
 
• **Department of Information Technology:-**
 
 
• It​ is responsible for the development and implementation of information technology policies and programs in India.
 
 
 
• **Department of Commerce:-**
 
 
• It​** **is responsible for promoting and regulating foreign trade and commerce in India.
